content: {"summary":"The July 2025 release added a filter on expires_at without an index, causing a full‑table scan that saturated the DB and timed out reservations on both inventory pods. The cause was confirmed by the simultaneous errors on both pods, high DB load, and a query plan showing a sequential scan on reservations with the new filter. The remediation was to build the missing index reservations_expires_at_idx using CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY.","likely_cause":"Missing index on the expires_at column introduced by the release, leading to a sequential scan of the reservations table.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Cause was confirmed by simultaneous errors on both inventory pods, high DB load, and a query plan showing a sequential scan on reservations with the new filter","evidence_ids":["INC-0059#0","INC-0059#1"],"quote":"The errors were on both inventory pods at the same moment and the database was working hard"},{"text":"The missing index reservations_expires_at_idx was built with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY","evidence_ids":["INC-0059#1"],"quote":"We built the missing index, `reservations_expires_at_idx`, with `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`"}],"next_checks":["Verify the new index is present and used by the query plan","Monitor reservation query latency after future releases that add filters","Add a checklist step to ensure indexes exist for new filter columns"]}
